review_type: Independent internal source-access and preservation review with explicit role separation; AI-assisted, not qualified external biological review.

independence.peer_and_root_sources: Reviewer independently inspected N01/N02 captures and selected API extraction, N03-N05 discovery limits, root S01-S04 captures and institutional link chain, plus capture identities/accounting.
independence.reviewer_produced_V01: One exact-DOI Europe PMC access attempt was produced by this reviewer; its access-failure capture and accounting were cross-reviewed by root. It is not represented as an independently acquired reviewer-verified source document.
independence.root_cross_review_scope: V01 is a tool-only access failure, without authenticated HTTP status, metadata body or full-text target. No absence inference is accepted.

accepted_checks: Official API exact DOI/version/date and literal cc_by/NA metadata match the captured record.
API JATS link is explicit; its one request returned 429 without XML.
Institutional title/authors/year and DOI-labelled link are distinguished from an inspected literal DOI target; following the PuRe link reveals item_3696516 with a tool-reported 403.
PuRe REST and Europe PMC access failures have no authenticated HTTP status/body; empty search and failure responses do not prove record or data absence.
All twelve capture/receipt byte identities reconcile; ten tool-level calls include eleven conservative fetch/query attempts, within the twelve-acquisition cap.

Article licensing does not license unrecovered data, code or KEGG resources. Original synthesis and selected factual metadata are attributed; raw captures, contacts, private paths and secrets remain unpublished.
The scoped local filename sets match across 11224 paths and twelve named current identities match; this is not exhaustive content coverage.
All 311 prior checkpoint artifact identities and all 26 study plus 18 planning NULLs remain intact at source-review time.
rejected_inferences: No dataset/KEGG destination, versioned sample manifest or explicit sample/genotype/replicate join is authenticated.
Article metadata and historical genotype/readout units do not supply native mutation births, single-new-mutant establishment, actual stock sequence or custody.
The API abstract single-characterised-mutation phrase does not reconcile the R36 WS-1 two-substitution description; other R36 stock/locus conflicts remain unresolved.
No native biological fit, new theorem, route-level transport bound, independent biological replication or new methods version follows.
publication_scope: GitHub provenance checkpoint only; no new scientific package, website finding or Zenodo update. Exact integration and committed-head review are separate.
